text:
Leila: Heads-up: proposal to tighten RBAC for on-prem runtime tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Goal: remove cluster-wide editor perms and force all KMS ops through a kms-proxy sidecar. Need quick technical review.
Kai: I'm free. What's the minimal grant for node-agent to read sealed secrets post-change?
Leila: node-agent should only have a tiny SA with permission to GET secrets in redwood-agent namespace and call the local proxy endpoint. No direct cloud KMS keys.
Jordan: So proxy holds the actual KMS principal/credentials and kube-level netpols restrict which pods can reach it. That reduces blast radius.
Sam: How will we authenticate original caller through the proxy? We need to capture the originating SA for audits.
Leila: Proxy will require mTLS on the pod-to-proxy channel and accept JWTs from the pod SA. It will emit original_subject in the audit record.
DevSecBot: Reminder: when changing RBAC, confirm ServiceAccount token volume projection is enabled for all clusters (security control: bound-service-account-token-volume).
Kai: Netpols: we should allow agent namespace -> proxy namespace TCP/443 and allow DNS clusters and internal HSM CIDR for on-prem. Example I drafted: ```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: agent-egress-to-proxy
  namespace: redwood-agent
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: node-agent
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: kms-proxy
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.200.0.0/16
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 15002
```
Jordan: Good. For onprem HSMs the ipBlock will be customer-specific; docs need a template for operators.
Sam: Audit retention: customers want 90 days immutable logs, but some require 7 years. How do we support both?
ops-oncall: We support multiple retention SLAs. Implement write-once object upload (append-only) to local object-store and replicate/sync to customer storage. We'll add lifecycle rules per-customer.
Leila: Audit content: timestamp, request_id, src_pod, src_sa, proxy_sa, key_fingerprint, operation, hsm_attestation, outcome, signed_log_sig. We must not log plaintext secrets.
Kai: Signed_log_sig — recommend cluster-level ed25519 key stored in sealed secret, rotated every 30 days. Logs signed before upload.
DevSecBot: CVE check: dependency scan found vulnerable YAML-parser lib in proxy image (CVE-2026-0001). Current plan?
Sam: We have a fixed build but some customers are on older pinned images. We should push patched image and trigger advisory + optional forced upgrade for critical sites.
Jordan: Rolling strategy: stage->canary label (env=staging, env=canary)->10%->50%->100%. If proxy parsing feature is behind feature flag, flip off during rollout to reduce risk.
Leila: Emergency rollback: plan A = rollback proxy deployment to previous image; plan B = enable node-agent direct KMS calls with strict rate limiting and enhanced audit (only if customer allows). Document fail-open vs fail-closed behavior per customer.
ops-oncall: I'll draft customer advisory and schedule maintenance windows. Also will coordinate with support to update KB article.
Sam: Inventory task: list all SAs with cluster-admin or edit across onprem clusters. I can run kube-scanner and output owners.
Kai: For RBAC change Yaml, here's a short Role granting only secret GET for node-agent: ```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  namespace: redwood-agent
  name: node-agent-read-secrets
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
```
Leila: Add RoleBinding to bind to node-agent SA, and make sure cert-rotator uses dedicated sa scoped to cert secrets.
Jordan: Also add audit-webhook that rejects any RoleBinding granting cluster-admin to non-approved groups; automation should open a PR to fix.
DevSecBot: Note: enable immutable audit logs in cluster (audit.k8s.io policy) and stream to local append-only store.
Leila: Summary action items: Sam - inventory & list of high-perm SAs (due EOD). Kai - netpol templates + HSM cidr template (due tomorrow). Jordan - emergency rollback docs & feature-flag gating (due tomorrow AM). Ops-oncall - customer advisory + maintenance windows (today). Maria: will you be on hand to push patched proxy images?
Sam: infra-bot: build triggered for redwood/kms-proxy:v2026.2.
Leila: Thanks everyone. We'll run a staging dry-run at 02:30 UTC then start the onprem rollouts during the maintenance windows.
